_comment: Project-level hooks for Harmonic Discovery Engine. ALWAYS-ON: PreToolUse 'guard_signals_db' asks before any tool call that could overwrite/delete the live signals.db; UserPromptSubmit 'inject_context' injects branch + canonical-plan + ownership rules each turn; PostToolUse 'ruff_format_lint' runs ruff on .py edits (advisory/report-only by default -- set HARMONIC_RUFF_MODE=fix to auto-format, HARMONIC_RUFF_BLOCK=1 to make advisory findings blocking). PARKED (scripts still on disk, intentionally unregistered): postedit_protected_paths.ps1 + stop_verify.ps1 enforced the EXPIRED 2026-04-19 Step 4B regret window on the prep/red-team-hybrid-prep branch; firing them on main would re-impose the R19-lifted freeze. For a current freeze use gstack /freeze + /guard. Run /hooks to verify what is loaded.
